newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: PFI 2 for five rights issue successful.
newsitem.headline: PFI 2 for five rights issue successful.

text.p: Property for Industry Ltd on Friday said it had successfully completed its two for five renounceable rights issue.
The issue closed on October 11 with applications received for over 98 percent of the new shares on offer.

As the issue was fully underwritten by Ord Minnett Securities NZ, PFI said it would issue all of the 42.272 million new shares that were on offer and will receive the full proceeds of the issue of $29.6 million.

"The environment of purchasing prime industrial property continues to be favourable and the successful completion of the rights issue means that PFI is well placed to take advantage of the opportunities it sees to purchase quality properties on attractive yields," chairman Allan Lockie said.
"Increasing the size of the company has the additional benefits of spreading risk across a greater number of properties and tenants, diversifying PFI's shareholder base and improving liquidity."
